enabled.description: Toggle the Kerberos connector plugin on or off.

krb5_conf.description: Path to the main Kerberos configuration file (krb5.conf).

keytab_path.description: Path to the Kerberos keytab file used by the service.

service_principal.description: The Kerberos service principal for this router.

realm.description: The Kerberos realm this connector serves.

kdcs.description: List of KDC servers. At least one is required; ports are optional (default 88).

port.description: KDC port (typically 88). Use null for default.

admin_server.description: Kerberos administration server for realm management.

port.description: Admin port (typically 749). Use null for default.

default_lifetime.description: Default ticket lifetime in hours (must be ≥ 1).

max_renewable_lifetime.description: Maximum renewable ticket lifetime in hours (must be ≥ default_lifetime).

enable_dns_realms.description: Enable DNS SRV record lookups for realm discovery.

canonicalize.description: Canonicalize hostnames in principal names (e.g., resolve CNAMEs).

log_file.description: Path to plugin log file. Use 'syslog' to send logs to system logger.

ldaps.description: Optional list of LDAP servers for principal/user lookup (e.g., in distributed deployments).

port.description: LDAP port (389 for unencrypted, 636 for LDAPS). Use null for default.

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN to bind as for LDAP (empty for anonymous bind).

ldap_bind_password_file.description: Path to file containing LDAP bind password (if used).

ldap_search_base.description: LDAP search base for user/principal entries.

ldap_user_filter.description: LDAP filter for user lookup. %u will be replaced by the principal name.

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for LDAP/KDC connections where supported.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS trust validation.

client_cert_path.description: Optional client certificate for mutual TLS (PEM format).

client_key_path.description: Optional client private key for mutual TLS (PEM format).

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent network connections to Kerberos services.

connect_timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds (0 for infinite).

request_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a full Kerberos request (seconds).

retry_count.description: Number of retries for transient failures.

fallback_to_tcp.description: Fall back to TCP if UDP response is truncated.

prefer_udp.description: Prefer UDP when packet size permits (reduces overhead).

enable_fast.description: Enable FAST (Anonymous or authenticated armor) for secure authentication.

fast_armor_cache.description: Cache location for FAST armor tickets (e.g., FILE:/path).

preauth_types.description: Ordered list of preauth type OIDs/numbers to offer (e.g., PA-ETYPE-INFO2=18, PA-PW-SALT=19).
